description: Small kiosk tenancy inside a terminal building, Level 2; architectural detail-design set with a general arrangement plan (printed room areas and overall area), RCP and joinery. Answer key for the autonomous AI tasks (Card P).

P0_rooms.notes: Areas as printed on the general arrangement plan (p. 5). The plan also prints the overall kiosk area A = 40.8 m2 and a 1 m2 fire-hose-reel cupboard (not a conditioned room). Whether the remaining open kiosk floor is part of 'Service Counter' is not settled by the drawing, so it is not keyed.

P5_roof.evidence: Kiosk on Level 2 inside a terminal building; the space above is the terminal, not open sky.

P2_north.evidence: No north arrow on the general arrangement, RCP, top-view or set-out plans, or in the title blocks (checked 2026-10-05). The correct result is to apply no north; facade sun stays not assessed.

P3_boundaries.evidence: Kiosk on Level 2 inside the terminal: no wall faces outdoors, so 'external' is always wrong. The Service Counter is open to the terminal concourse (mall) or shares the Office wall (internal). The Office backs onto base-building space (fire hose reel cupboard) whose class is not settled, so neighbouring space is accepted for it.
